questions.target: investor 与 investigator 的角色
questions.skill: 辨别投入资金与核查信息的动作
questions.passage: A town tested an insulated cabinet at a food market. A group of investors put money into the project after reading estimates of how much traders could save on ice. The council hired investigators to check the figures before expanding the trial. They found that a colder month explained part of the fall in costs. The investment paid for two additional cabinets. The investigation helped the council decide where to place them, so that it could compare the results under different conditions.
questions.q: According to the text, how was the investment used?
o: Checking why traders had been spending less on ice.
Choosing which market stalls would test the cabinets.
Establishing how the temperature affected sales.
Buying more cabinets to extend the market trial.
questions.answer_support: The investment paid for two additional cabinets.

exp.trans: 市场试用了隔热柜。投资者看到预计能节省冰块开支后投入资金。议会另请调查人员核对数字，发现较冷的天气也有影响。投资支付了两台新增柜子的费用。调查帮助决定柜子放在哪儿，以比较不同条件下的结果。
exp.structure: 两组人分别由 put money into 和 hired ... to check 引出。末两句用 investment 和 investigation 分别承接各自的行动及成果。
exp.other: insulated（隔热的）、trader（商贩）、estimate（估算）、expand（扩大）。
exp.meaning: investment 在这里是投入的资金，investor 是投资者。investigation 是查证过程，investigator 为负责调查的人。
exp.rest: 核查开支及确定新试验地点来自调查。文中也没有断定温度怎样影响销量。购买柜子由所投入的资金承担。

questions.target: beyond 与沿边、横穿的空间区别
questions.skill: 以文中地标判断位置与经过的区域
questions.passage: A field worker surveyed the eelgrass growing near the mouth of a harbour. She marked out a strip along the sea wall so that later teams could repeat the count. She found the plants within this strip, but could not tell whether they reached beyond the line of buoys that marked its seaward edge. A second team took a boat across the strip the following week and counted plants farther out. The extended survey helped show where the beds ended.
questions.q: Which area does "beyond the line of buoys" describe?
o: The water between the sea wall and the buoys.
The water farther out than the marker buoys.
The water immediately around the marker buoys.
The part of the strip nearest the sea wall.
questions.answer_support: beyond the line of buoys that marked its seaward edge

exp.trans: 调查人员先沿海堤划出一条带状区域，发现里面有鳗草，但不知道鳗草是否延伸到外侧浮标线以外。第二组后来乘船横穿这一区域，到更远的水域统计，帮助确定鳗草丛的边界。
exp.structure: 海堤和浮标线确定了最初的调查范围。that marked its seaward edge 说明浮标标的是条带朝海的一侧。后句的 farther out 指向同一方向。
exp.other: eelgrass（鳗草）、sea wall（海堤）、buoy（浮标）、seaward（朝海的）。
exp.meaning: beyond the line 描述超过这条边界的位置，沿文中的方向是浮标线外更靠海的水域。
exp.rest: 两个在条带内的选项都没有越过浮标线。浮标周围也未必在线外。文中的 along 表示沿海堤延伸，across 表示从条带一侧到另一侧的移动。

questions.skill: 区分结果核验、消息公开与实施授权
questions.q: A hospital trial finds that a scheduling tool reduces missed appointments. The methods panel accepts the results after checking the analysis, and a staff newsletter reports the trial. Routine use must nevertheless wait for the operations board to approve a staffing plan. Which event authorises the hospital to start using the tool routinely?
o: Acceptance of the trial analysis by the methods panel.
Publication of the trial results in the staff newsletter.
The operations board's approval of the staffing plan.
The trial team's observation of fewer missed appointments.

exp.trans: 一家医院的试验发现，一种预约安排工具减少了爽约。方法审核小组检查分析后认可了结果，员工通讯也报道了这项试验。不过，常规使用仍须等待运营委员会批准人员配置计划。哪个事件授权医院开始常规使用该工具？答案是人员配置计划获批。
exp.structure: A hospital trial + finds + that从句给出试验发现；The methods panel + accepts + the results说明核验阶段。Routine use + must wait + for the operations board to approve a staffing plan说明实施仍受另一项决定约束。nevertheless连接结果已获认可与尚不能常规实施的转折。
exp.other: scheduling tool 预约安排工具；miss an appointment 爽约；methods panel 方法审核小组；staffing plan 人员配置计划；authorise 授权。
exp.meaning: 题目问开始常规实施的授权条件。独立核查在本文确实发生，却只让研究结果获得认可，不能替代运营委员会的实施批准。不能把所有过程题都机械答成独立验证。
exp.rest: 审核小组认可的是试验分析，不是常规使用的授权；员工通讯负责传播消息，没有审批权；试验团队观察到效果是提出采用建议的证据起点，仍未满足文中保留的实施条件。

questions.target: 根据 hinder 判断影响性质
questions.skill: 区分影响的利弊、程度和时长
questions.passage: A nature reserve built a boardwalk to keep visitors off soft ground. The boards did protect the plants nearest the entrance. But one section crossed a channel through which rainwater had previously flowed into a shallow pool. Its supports hindered the flow of water. The pool dried earlier than usual and fewer birds nested nearby. Although the path remained popular, the reserve manager said its success should also be judged by whether wildlife could continue to use the pool.
questions.q: What problem does the passage identify in the pool area?
o: Conditions became less suitable for some of the wildlife.
The boardwalk brought additional visitors to the pool.
Changes in water flow had little effect on wildlife.
The effect on nesting faded once the water level settled.
questions.answer_support: Its supports hindered the flow of water. The pool dried earlier than usual and fewer birds nested nearby.

exp.trans: 保护区修步道来避免游人踩入软地，入口附近的植物确实得到了保护。不过步道的支撑妨碍雨水流入浅池，池水比平时更早干涸，附近筑巢的鸟变少了。管理者认为还应按野生动物能否继续使用这个浅池来评价步道。
exp.structure: But 后面把关注点移到浅池。支撑挡住部分水流，紧接着的干涸和少鸟筑巢说明这个变化有什么影响。Although 所说的受欢迎是补充背景。
exp.other: boardwalk（木板步道）、channel（水渠）、support（支撑）、nest（筑巢）。
exp.meaning: hinder 表示妨碍。通过池水较早干涸及筑巢变少，可以概括出对局部野生动物的 adverse 影响。动词 impeded、obstructed 也可表示妨碍，要结合它们支配的事物判断后果。
exp.rest: 受欢迎没有交代浅池附近是否增加访客。文中给出了筑巢变化，未说作用微不足道，也未说明筑巢后来恢复。

questions.q: After an appeal, a referee reduced a player's suspension from six matches to two, but kept the penalty. The revised sanction is best described as:
o: more lasting because it follows a formal hearing
more severe because it still includes a penalty
more lenient, although punishment still remains
less certain because the referee did not decide

exp.trans: 申诉后停赛从六场减为两场，但处罚并未取消。
exp.structure: reduced...from...to...表达数量下降；but kept the penalty限定处罚仍在。
exp.other: lenient宽大的；severe严厉的；suspension停赛。
exp.meaning: 更宽大等价于处罚程度更轻，不等于完全免罚。
exp.rest: 延长、加重或裁判尚未决定均与已经明确减轻处罚相反。

questions.q: The new filing system was advertised as a complete fix. The inspector disagreed: it still left a host of problems unresolved. Which summary matches the inspector's view?
o: Many problems still needed attention.
The system needed a human presenter.
Only one minor problem was left over.
The problems had all been dealt with.

exp.trans: 新归档系统被宣传为彻底解决方案，但检查员认为它仍留下大量未解决的问题。
exp.structure: 主干it left problems unresolved；a host of修饰复数problems，unresolved说明这些问题仍未解决。
exp.other: filing system归档系统；inspector检查员；unresolved未解决的。
exp.meaning: a host of整体表示大量，反驳complete fix所宣称的彻底解决。
exp.rest: human presenter把数量短语当作主持人；only one与大量相反；all dealt with忽略unresolved。

questions.q: A grant pays a university team to measure changes in distant stars' brightness. All observations are made from Earth. A note says the grant trains astronauts. Which correction best matches the work described?
o: It funds astronaut training rather than research about distant stars.
It funds astronomy; this research does not require a journey into space.
It funds space travel because observing stars means leaving the Earth.
It funds crew navigation rather than any study of the objects observed.

exp.trans: 一笔资助用于大学团队测量遥远恒星亮度的变化，所有观测都在地球完成。有说明称资金用来培养宇航员。如何纠正才符合所述工作？
exp.structure: pays...to measure说明研究任务；All observations...from Earth限制是否实际执行太空飞行；trains astronauts误把学科研究替成航天任务训练。
exp.other: grant研究资助；brightness亮度；observation观测；crew航天乘组。
exp.meaning: astronomy是天文学这一学科；astronaut是进入太空执行任务的人。研究遥远天体不要求研究者本人离开地球。
exp.rest: astronaut training把研究经费误成乘组训练；means leaving the Earth是无依据规则；crew navigation与测量恒星亮度这一研究任务不同。

questions.q: Despite her fame, the author washed dishes with the volunteers and asked for no special treatment. Her manner was ___.
o: unpredictable
hostile
unpretentious
perplexing

exp.trans: 尽管很有名，这位作家还是和志愿者一起洗碗，没有要求任何特殊待遇。她为人不摆架子。
exp.structure: 第一句主干：the author（主语）+ washed / asked（并列谓语）；dishes是washed的宾语，for no special treatment是asked后的介词短语。Despite her fame是让步状语。第二句：Her manner + was + unpretentious。
exp.other: despite 尽管；fame 名气；volunteer 志愿者；special treatment 特殊待遇。
exp.meaning: unpretentious表示朴实、不自命不凡，描述作风而非能否预测。
exp.rest: unpredictable：无法预测的，常搭配weather或behaviour；这里没有反复无常的线索。hostile：敌对的，常用be hostile to；与合作洗碗不符。perplexing：令人困惑的，常修饰question或situation；这里强调不摆架子。

transient-investor-roles.skill: 根据持续时间理解形近词
transient-investor-roles.passage: The coordinators of a language-exchange site measure its popularity by the number of people who sign in each week. A reviewer applied a different test. Some members used the site only to find someone for a class assignment. They rarely returned once their assignments had been submitted. The reviewer describes these visitors as transient and leaves them out when estimating how many lasting partnerships the site supports. The site's designers, who make their figures public, agree that a busy week may tell little about how often people meet again.
transient-investor-roles.q: Why does the reviewer describe these visitors as "transient"?
o: They change partners whenever their classes change.
They use the site for a short time and rarely return.
They expect the site to make their exchanges public.
They do their assignments with a regular partner.
transient-investor-roles.answer_support: They rarely returned once their assignments had been submitted.

exp.trans: 语言交换网站以每周登录人数衡量受欢迎程度。有些人只为完成作业上站，交作业后很少回来。评估者把他们视为短期访客，在统计持久的学习伙伴关系时扣除这部分人。网站公开数据，也承认登录热度说明不了后续见面的频率。
exp.structure: 先看谁被称为 transient，再向前找这些访客的行为。作业提交是他们很少回来之前的时间节点。末句中 who make their figures public 补充设计者如何处理数据。
exp.other: sign in（登录）、submit（提交）、leave out（排除）、lasting（持久的）。
exp.meaning: transient 写访客停留得短。transparent 写透明、公开，可用来描述数据披露的做法。这里公开数据的是网站设计者。
exp.rest: 文中没有描述访客反复换搭档或已拥有固定搭档。公开数据也没有说明访客希望公开自己的交流内容。

spatial-preposition.target: through 所表示的从内部穿过
spatial-preposition.skill: 用语境重建运动的路径
spatial-preposition.passage: A team was testing a window shade for a reading room. A thick blind kept pedestrians from seeing inside, but it meant that people at the tables had to use lamps even on bright days. The second shade, which was made of tightly woven cloth, hid the desks from the street while allowing daylight to pass through the fabric. The designers could therefore leave the shade lowered for most of the afternoon without having to turn the lights on.
spatial-preposition.q: What happens when daylight passes "through the fabric"?
o: It moves along the outer surface of the cloth.
It reaches the room around the edges of the shade.
It travels from one face of the cloth to the other.
It falls on the pavement just beyond the window.
spatial-preposition.answer_support: hid the desks from the street while allowing daylight to pass through the fabric

exp.trans: 阅览室第一种窗帘挡住街上视线，但白天也得开灯。第二种紧密织成的窗帘遮住了桌子，仍让日光透过布料，因此大部分下午可放下窗帘而不用开灯。
exp.structure: which was made of tightly woven cloth 补充窗帘材质。主句说明第二种窗帘同时做到遮挡视线和透过日光，这两个效果解释了最后一句。
exp.other: shade 和 blind 在这里都指窗帘或遮光装置。pedestrian 表示行人，woven 表示织成的。
exp.meaning: through 说明光穿过布本身，从一侧到另一侧。carve a channel through packed snow 也是在材料内部开出一段通道。
exp.rest: along 是沿着表面或边缘，around the edges 是绕开材料，beyond the window 只给出越过边界的位置。具体路径要看句子所说的动作。

process-stage-role.target: 个人估计 vs 集体验证
process-stage-role.skill: 区分主张起点和取得认可所需条件
process-stage-role.q: An analyst estimates that the city has room for 4,000 people in emergency shelters. Officials will use this figure for evacuation plans only after independent teams verify the counts and agree on a common estimate. What makes the figure suitable for official planning?
o: The analyst's personal familiarity with the shelters.
Verification and agreement across independent teams.
The public release of a large numerical estimate.
The analyst's decision to avoid revising the original number.

exp.trans: 一位分析员估计城市应急避难所可容纳4000人；只有独立团队核查数据并就统一估计达成一致，政府才会在疏散计划中采用这一数字。
exp.structure: An analyst + estimates + that从句提出最初主张；Officials + will use + this figure ... only after ...，only after指出主张转化为官方依据所需的条件。
exp.other: emergency shelter 应急避难所；evacuation 疏散；estimate 估计；verify 核验。
exp.meaning: 题干问的是让一项初步主张获得认可所需要的机制。个人估计是起点，独立团队核查与达成一致是条件；不能因为看到analyst就选个人经验。
exp.rest: 个人熟悉情况只能解释估计如何产生；数字公开和规模大都不能自动证明可靠；拒绝修订反而与核查机制相冲突。

process-stage-role.target: 单次发现 vs 跨来源确认
process-stage-role.skill: 过程终点与条件的角色识别
process-stage-role.q: A driver first reports cracks on a bridge, but the warning is not issued to the whole region until engineers compare photographs, inspect the structure, and confirm the hazard. What is required for the initial report to become an official warning?
o: A more vivid description from the first driver.
Agreement that the first driver deserves public credit.
Public enthusiasm for an alarming photograph.
Independent assessment and confirmation of the reported danger.

exp.trans: 司机最先报告桥面裂缝，但直到工程师比对照片、检查结构并确认危险，地区警报才正式发布。
exp.structure: A driver + reports + cracks引入起点；the warning + is not issued ... until engineers compare, inspect, and confirm，用not...until表示形成正式警报的必要过程。
exp.other: crack 裂缝；structure 结构；hazard 危险；issue a warning 发布警报。
exp.meaning: 个人首次报告不等于正式被认可；由多个步骤进行独立评估并确认，才使主张具有可推广的效力。注意题目问required而非who noticed it first。
exp.rest: 报告更生动不能替代核验；给报告人荣誉不是警报成立条件；公众情绪不能替代工程检查。

process-stage-role.skill: 按提问定位过程中的决定而非总选最后一步
process-stage-role.q: A technician noticed an unusual label on a food shipment and asked a supervisor whether it should be checked. The supervisor marked the shipment 'hold', stopping dispatch. A laboratory later found the contents safe, and the quality manager signed the release form. Which event directly stopped the shipment from leaving?
o: The technician's request for advice about the label.
The supervisor's decision to put the shipment on hold.
The laboratory's conclusion that the contents were safe.
The quality manager's signature on the release form.

exp.trans: 技术员发现一批食品的标签异常，询问主管是否应检查。主管将这批货标为暂扣，停止发运。实验室后来确认货物内容安全，质量经理签署了放行单。哪个事件直接阻止了货物运出？是主管作出的暂扣决定。
exp.structure: The technician + noticed ... and asked ...是发现和上报；whether it should be checked是询问内容，其中should be checked为被动谓语。The supervisor + marked + the shipment + hold，后接stopping dispatch说明结果。found the contents safe为find加宾语和形容词补语；signed the release form属于后来的放行阶段。
exp.other: shipment 一批货物；put on hold 暂停、暂扣；dispatch 发运；release form 放行单；contents 所装物品。
exp.meaning: 先确定题目问的是停止发运，而非最早发现异常、确认安全或最终放行。直接产生停运结果的是主管的暂扣决定。过程角色题必须按问题定位阶段，不能一概选最后的正式批准。
exp.rest: 技术员询问是否检查，是上报起点，文中实际停运由主管决定；实验室认定安全发生在之后，支持解除疑虑；经理签放行单允许后续运出，与停止运出方向相反。

adverse-impact-dimension.target: 把影响性质和持续时间分开
adverse-impact-dimension.skill: 根据时间节点判断问题何时终止
adverse-impact-dimension.passage: Actors at a theatre sometimes missed costume fittings when they changed rehearsal rooms without telling the wardrobe team. A shared calendar was introduced to solve this problem. In its first week, access settings prevented some costume staff from entering appointments. That impeded their efforts to arrange fittings. After the settings were corrected, all departments could use the calendar and the disruption did not recur. The director said the experience could help the theatre prepare for its next change in software.
adverse-impact-dimension.q: What does the passage establish about the initial disruption?
o: It continued after more staff could use the calendar.
It ended once an early access problem was resolved.
It was too slight to affect the fitting schedule.
It began when the theatre expanded access to the calendar.
adverse-impact-dimension.answer_support: After the settings were corrected, all departments could use the calendar and the disruption did not recur.

exp.trans: 剧院用共享日历解决换排练室后漏掉服装试穿的问题。第一周的权限设置使部分服装人员无法录入预约，影响了排期。修正设置后，各部门均可使用，问题未再发生。剧院可用这段经历改进下一次软件变更。
exp.structure: in its first week 交代新问题开始，after the settings were corrected 交代问题终止。
exp.other: fitting（服装试穿）、wardrobe team（服装团队）、impede（妨碍）、recur（再次发生）。
exp.meaning: impeded 表明当时有不利影响。此题还给了明确的结束节点，因此可以概括为 temporary。判断持续时间要找时间证据。
exp.rest: 困扰来自初期权限限制，并确实影响了排期。扩展权限之后问题没有再出现。

evaluation-vocab.q: Her critique of the campaign's lameness was spot-on: the slogan was vague, the evidence weak, and the call to action easy to ignore. Which reading is best?
o: 她对宣传乏力之处的批评非常准确。
她因为腿脚不便而无法批评这个宣传。
她只是随意夸奖了这个宣传。
她认为宣传证据充分，只是口号太短。

exp.trans: 她对这项宣传乏力、差劲之处的批评非常到位：口号模糊、证据薄弱，而且行动号召很容易被忽视。
exp.structure: Her critique是主语，was是系动词，spot-on是表语；of the campaign's lameness说明批评对象。冒号后给出为什么说“准确”。
exp.other: vague 模糊的；call to action 行动号召；ignore 忽视；evidence 证据。
exp.meaning: critique=批判性评论/分析；lameness在比喻语境中可指乏力、差劲；spot-on=非常准确、说到点子上。
exp.rest: 把lameness机械译成身体跛不合语境；把critique/spot-on反成随意夸奖也不对；认为evidence充分则与weak evidence直接相反。

evaluation-vocab.q: The brochure pleads with readers to donate, but much of it is filled with irrelevant detail. Its most glaring flaw is that it never explains where the money goes. Which paraphrase is accurate?
o: 宣传册恳求捐款却细节跑题，最明显的缺陷是没说资金去向。
宣传册命令读者捐款，丰富的无关细节构成它最大的优点。
宣传册平静陈述捐款事实，全文没有向读者表达请求。
宣传册最关键的证据就是细节，irrelevant表示与主题密切相关。

exp.trans: 宣传册恳求读者捐款，但其中充斥着无关细节；最明显的缺陷是它从未解释资金流向。
exp.structure: The brochure是主语，pleads是谓语；but后much of it is filled...；Its most glaring flaw is that...是系表结构，that从句说明缺陷内容。
exp.other: brochure 宣传册；donate 捐款；where the money goes 资金去向；detail 细节。
exp.meaning: plead=恳求；irrelevant=无关的；glaring flaw=非常明显的缺陷。三者都是评价/语气词，不能只按最熟悉的字面义处理。
exp.rest: pleads是恳求而非命令，也不是平静地不作请求；flaw是缺陷而非优点；irrelevant指无关，不能把它解释为关键且密切相关。

evaluation-vocab.skill: 抽象评价取向与词义边界
evaluation-vocab.q: A help centre rewards agents only for ending calls quickly. An essay notes that callers with complex problems are repeatedly cut off, then says, 'The trouble is what counts as success here.' What is the essay criticising?
o: A rigid ethical code that demands flawless conduct.
The complete absence of any measure of performance.
The equal weight given to speed and careful advice.
A narrow value system that puts speed above service.

exp.trans: 帮助中心只奖励迅速结束通话的工作人员。文章指出复杂问题来电屡遭挂断，随后批评这里把什么当作成功。批评对象是把速度置于服务之上的狭窄评价取向。
exp.structure: 首句only限定奖励依据；第二句essay为notes和says的主语，that从句提供评价造成的具体后果；引语中的what counts as success是名词性从句，指被当作成功的标准。
exp.other: agent工作人员；cut off中断通话；count as被视为；flawless无瑕疵的。
exp.meaning: distorted values批评何种目标被抬高、何种责任被忽视；a rigid moral code说的是道德规范过于严格，不能只因都涉及好坏就当成同义。
exp.rest: “要求道德完美的僵硬准则”错置了批评对象；“完全没有绩效标准”忽略只按速度奖励的明确标准；“速度和认真建议同权”与only及cut off的后果不符。

evaluation-vocab.target: distorted values / 具体评价标准
evaluation-vocab.q: An awards committee praises productions for ticket income while treating honest accounts of costs as an inconvenience. A critic calls this 'distorted values'. Which explanation fits?
o: Financial results are placed above honest conduct.
Ethical rules are enforced with excessive strictness.
Artistic work is no longer judged by any standard.
Every production has deliberately falsified accounts.

exp.trans: 评奖委员会赞赏作品的票房，却把如实交代成本当作麻烦。评论者称之为价值观扭曲，意思是经济结果被置于诚实行事之上。
exp.structure: 首句committee为主语，praises为谓语；while treating...补充与之对照的做法，treat A as B表示把A看作B。第二句critic为calls的主语，this回指前述评价取向。
exp.other: production文艺作品；ticket income票房收入；account账目、说明；inconvenience麻烦。
exp.meaning: 抽象评价必须回到支持它的具体对照：重票房、轻如实报告。它既不是道德过严，也不能证明所有参与者实际造假。
exp.rest: “道德规范执行过严”与不重视诚实的方向相反；“完全没有判断标准”忽略已有的票房标准；“所有作品均故意造假”加入了原文没有确认的全称事实。

evaluation-vocab.q: A factory code replaces automatic closure for a first violation with a written warning. Compared with the old response, the new sanction is:
o: more permanent for every new breach of the code
less severe for an initial breach of the rule
more punitive for any first-time safety mistake
more frequent because all warnings recur weekly

exp.trans: 工厂新守则把首次违规的自动停业改成书面警告。
exp.structure: replaces A with B指替换；for a first violation限定适用情形。
exp.other: sanction制裁；punitive惩罚性的；violation违规。
exp.meaning: 从停业到书面警告体现处罚力度减轻，即less severe / more lenient。
exp.rest: 不是更持久、更严厉，也没有说明警告每周发生。

evaluation-vocab.q: An audit found repeated falsification of equipment logs and called these acts 'malpractices.' In this context, what does the term mean?
o: Improper conduct rather than ordinary work routines.
Harmless professional habits carried out each day.
Authorized training sessions for junior technicians.
Routine storage of the equipment maintenance logs.

exp.trans: 审计发现反复伪造设备记录，并把这些行为称为malpractices。
exp.structure: called these acts将伪造行为称作不当行为；falsification是定义线索。
exp.other: malpractice不当行为；falsification伪造；audit审计。
exp.meaning: 词缀mal-表示不当，与单独的practices日常做法不同。
exp.rest: 无害习惯、获批准培训和普通存档均不是反复伪造记录。

social-cure-vocab.q: The report offers a host of examples of a 'social cure' in which community groups use peer support to improve health habits. Which paraphrase is accurate?
o: It gives a doctor's treatment plan for patients with one illness.
It gives many cases of peer groups influencing healthier habits.
It describes a meeting held to display different treatments.
It identifies peer support as a source of illness in the group.

exp.trans: 报告举出了大量“社会干预”实例：社区团体利用同伴支持来改善健康习惯。
exp.structure: The report是主语，offers是谓语，a host of examples是宾语；of a social cure说明这些例子属于哪类做法；in which引出其机制。
exp.other: peer support 同伴支持；community group 社区团体；health habit 健康习惯；intervention 干预。
exp.meaning: a host of = 大量、许多；social cure在这类语境中是借助社会/群体机制的干预办法，不是字面医学药物。
exp.rest: social cure不是一份医生处方；a host of意为大量，不是主持展示会；peer support用于改善健康习惯，不是被说成疾病来源。

social-cure-vocab.q: An antismoking campaign used the invitation 'Join us for a smoke-free week' rather than a threat. Here antismoking and invitation most nearly mean:
o: 反对吸烟的 / 邀请
促进吸烟的 / 强迫
反对广告的 / 请帖纸张
治疗吸烟的 / 命令

exp.trans: 一个反吸烟宣传活动用“和我们一起过无烟周吧”这样的邀请，而不是威胁。
exp.structure: An antismoking campaign是主语，used是谓语，the invitation是宾语；rather than a threat形成对比。
exp.other: smoke-free 无烟的；campaign 宣传活动；threat 威胁；rather than 而不是。
exp.meaning: anti-表示反对/抵制；antismoking=反吸烟的。invitation在这里是“邀请、邀请意味”，不一定指实体请帖。
exp.rest: 其余选项要么把anti方向反了，要么把invitation误作强迫/命令或仅限实体请帖。

social-cure-vocab.q: A harbour will host a boat festival. Organizers expect a host of small vessels to arrive. How do the two uses of host differ?
o: Both describe the owner of each vessel.
Both describe a person presenting a show.
First: provide the venue; second: many boats.
First: many venues; second: own the boats.

exp.trans: 港口将举办船艇节，组织者预计大量小船会到来。
exp.structure: 第一句host是及物动词，宾语a boat festival；第二句a host of是修饰small vessels的数量短语。
exp.other: harbour港口；vessel船只；venue举办地点。
exp.meaning: 同一个拼写在不同句法位置表达举办与大量，不能统一套用主人义。
exp.rest: owner和presenter都把两处当人物名词；many venues颠倒第一处的动词结构，own the boats也不符合第二处数量义。

astronomy-word-family.q: One person analyses galaxy data to test a scientific model. Another pilots a crewed spacecraft during an orbital mission. Which pair names the roles described, in that order?
o: Astronaut; astronomer studying data for a ground-based project.
Astronomy; astronaut flying a crewed spacecraft while in orbit.
Astronomer; astronaut flying a crewed spacecraft while in orbit.
Astronomical; astronomer taking part in an orbital crew mission.

exp.trans: 一个人分析星系数据以检验科学模型，另一个人在轨道任务中驾驶载人飞船。按这个顺序，应如何称呼两人的工作身份？
exp.structure: One...Another...划分两个动作主体；analyses...to test是研究任务；pilots...during an orbital mission是实际航天任务。
exp.other: galaxy星系；dock对接；crewed载人的；orbital在轨的。
exp.meaning: astronomer是天文学研究者，astronaut是航天任务人员；astronomy是学科名，astronomical是形容词，不能直接替代人的职业名词。
exp.rest: Astronaut; astronomer交换了两个工作；Astronomy把学科名用于人；Astronomical把形容词用于人，并把驾驶飞船的航天任务误称天文研究角色。

astronomy-word-family.q: A concert hall receives a repair quote far above its entire annual income. The chair calls the price astronomical. What does astronomical mean here?
o: Based on the recorded movements of distant planets.
Paid as part of a trained astronaut's mission costs.
Calculated by scientists working in an observatory.
Extremely large compared with the hall's resources.

exp.trans: 音乐厅收到的维修报价远超其全年收入，负责人称价格astronomical。这里是什么意思？
exp.structure: far above its entire annual income给出数量尺度；astronomical作表语，评价price而非学科、人物或测量方式。
exp.other: repair quote维修报价；annual income年收入；resources可用资源。
exp.meaning: astronomical可以表示极其巨大的、天文数字般的；这里由价格与年收入的比较支持比喻义。此形容词是教学延伸，不新增为用户已确认框词。
exp.rest: 行星运动、宇航员任务开支和天文台计算都套入天文字面话题，忽略了句中唯一给出的金额比较。

astronomy-word-family.q: An orbital crew member publishes scientific research on pulsating stars. A profile calls her both an astronaut and an astronomer. Is that description inconsistent?
o: No; the two labels describe roles that one person may combine.
Yes; an astronomer can never take part in a mission in space.
Yes; astronomy names a kind of traveller rather than a science.
No; both labels always mean exactly the same kind of occupation.

exp.trans: 一名在轨乘组成员发表了研究脉动恒星的科学论文。人物介绍同时称她为宇航员和天文学家。这是否自相矛盾？
exp.structure: crew member与publishes scientific research提供两个独立角色依据；both...and...可以同时成立，不要求身份互斥。
exp.other: profile人物介绍；pulsating周期性脉动的；inconsistent不一致的。
exp.meaning: 两词含义不同，但一个人可兼具两种身份。区分词义不是制定天文学家绝不能去太空的错误规则。
exp.rest: can never加入职业互斥；a kind of traveller误解astronomy；always mean exactly the same则把两个可能重合的身份变成完全同义。

unpretentious.q: The scientist's office was surprisingly ___: plain shelves, an old desk, and no awards on display.
o: unpretentious
unpredictable
formidable
perplexing

diag.1: 把 unpretentious 和 unpredictable 混淆了：这里描述的是朴素、不摆架子的风格，不是“无法预测”。
diag.2: formidable 表示“令人敬畏的、难对付的”，与 plain / no awards 的语义方向相反。
diag.3: perplexing 表示“令人困惑的”，这里没有“难以理解”的线索。

exp.trans: 这位科学家的办公室出人意料地朴素：普通的书架、一张旧书桌，而且没有陈列任何奖项。
exp.structure: 主干：The scientist's office（主语）+ was（系动词）+ unpretentious（表语）。冒号后 plain shelves, an old desk, and no awards on display 是对“朴素”的具体说明。
exp.other: plain 普通的/朴素的；shelf 书架；on display 陈列着；award 奖项。
exp.meaning: unpretentious = 不装腔作势的、朴实低调的。注意：unpredictable 才是“无法预测的”。
exp.rest: unpredictable = 无法预测的；formidable = 令人敬畏的/难对付的；perplexing = 令人困惑的。这道题只有 unpretentious（朴素、不摆架子）与后面的普通书架、旧桌子、不展示奖项一致。

unpretentious.q: On the same phone, the app sometimes opens instantly and sometimes takes a full minute. Its response time is ___.
o: unpretentious
unpredictable
constant
reliable

exp.trans: 在同一部手机上，这个应用有时马上打开，有时却要整整一分钟。它的响应时间难以预测。
exp.structure: the app是主语；opens和takes是并列谓语，sometimes...and sometimes...形成对比。第二句：Its response time（主语）+ is（系动词）+ unpredictable（表语）。
exp.other: instantly 立刻；a full minute 整整一分钟；response time 响应时间；constant 恒定的。
exp.meaning: unpredictable来自predict，表示难以预测；这里说性能表现忽快忽慢。
exp.rest: unpretentious：朴实、不摆架子的，常修饰person/style，不表示快慢无法预测。constant：恒定的，与忽快忽慢相反。reliable：可靠的，常用reliable information/service，不能概括这里不稳定的时间表现。
